def sq(frame):
    rows=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return [rows[r][27:37] for r in range(34,44)]
def piece_bbox(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('p','W','O') and 50 < n['pixels'] < 250:
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            if min(rs)<20: continue
            if min(rs)>=33 and max(rs)<=45 and min(cs)>=26 and max(cs)<=38: continue
            return (n['color'],min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    return None

action(['SPACE'])
print('after white pour at SW:')
